column1: # The mod catalog: what can be switched on or off when the game is built.
# Declarations, not code: tools/mods.py reads this file; nothing about a mod is written in the tool.
# sim: yes if the mod changes what happens in the game (online players must match), no if it only changes the look or this computer.
# requires: mods that must also be on (space-separated, - for none).
# sources: the src/ files that hold the mod (each is compiled out when it is off).
# tests: tests/coop/ scripts that need the mod (shell globs, - for none).
